description: This Java class implements the ExternalAssetOwnersReadService interface, providing methods to retrieve transfer data, journal entries, and transfer details related to external asset owners within the Fineract investment module.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ExternalAssetOwnersReadService interface, providing methods to access external asset owner transfer and journal entry data.

methods.name: retrieveTransferData
methods.description: Retrieves transfer data based on loan ID, external loan ID, or external transfer ID, with pagination support.

methods.name: retrieveActiveTransferData
methods.description: Retrieves active transfer data for a given loan ID, external loan ID, or external transfer ID.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesOfTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries associated with a specific transfer ID, with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesOfOwner
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries for a specific owner external ID, with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveFirstTransferByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the first transfer record by external ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveLastTransferIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the last transfer ID by external ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveTransferData
methods.description: Retrieves transfer data by transfer ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getPageRequest
methods.description: Creates a PageRequest object with default offset and limit if not provided, sorted by 'id'.
